This limited pilot prepares classroom equipment. It is not a quest ID and does not complete CS01-CS08 early. The machine does not need to work for you to succeed. Assessment uses safety, documentation, reasoning, and approval gates.

## Baseline, photographs, and privacy {.unnumbered}

| Assigned condition or symptom | Power state and cables received | Data or privacy restriction |
|:--|:--|:--|
| | | |

**Photographs:** $\square$ front  $\square$ rear ports  $\square$ asset label only  $\square$ interior overview after approval  $\square$ cable locations before movement

Never photograph passwords, network secrets, private screens, or unnecessary serial numbers.

## Safety and ESD gate {.unnumbered}

**Students never:** open or probe inside a PSU, create a short, invent a fault, move unapproved parts, force a connector, or erase or partition a drive without written teacher approval. The PSU remains sealed.

**Controls:** $\square$ shut down  $\square$ unplugged  $\square$ discharged as directed  $\square$ ESD mat or approved grounded area  $\square$ wrist strap when directed  $\square$ parts held by edges

Stop for liquid, a swollen cell, burnt areas, damaged power connectors, loose metal, sharp damage, smoke, unusual smell, abnormal heat, or an unknown battery.

## Startup and diagnostic record {.unnumbered}

Use a wired keyboard during startup. Model documentation controls when keys differ.

| Machine | Key | Purpose | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| PC | F2 or Delete | firmware setup | |
| PC | F12 | boot selection | |
| Intel Mac | Option or Alt | Startup Manager | |
| Intel Mac | D / Option-D | Apple Diagnostics / Internet Diagnostics | |
| Intel Mac | Command-R / Option-Command-R | Recovery / Internet Recovery | |

Intel Macs use EFI or UEFI firmware rather than an ordinary PC BIOS. Record exactly what the assigned model shows. Do not change settings without approval.

**POST, firmware, or Apple Diagnostics evidence:** _____________________________________________________

## Xubuntu live-session acceptance tests {.unnumbered}

Boot the teacher-prepared, direct-written Xubuntu 26.04 LTS USB. A live session is a quick compatibility check. Its boot time is not a fair benchmark.

| Test | Green / yellow / red | Evidence or note |
|:--|:--:|:--|
| display, keyboard, and mouse | | |
| USB and Ethernet | | |
| Wi-Fi and sound | | |
| internal storage visibility | | |

## Triage classification {.unnumbered}

| Class | Meaning |
|:--|:--|
| Green | safe, stable, required tests pass, no unresolved data concern |
| Yellow | one approved repair, driver check, or closer review is needed |
| Red | stop condition, unsafe damage, unstable power, serious storage concern, or no safe student next step |

**Classification:** $\square$ green  $\square$ yellow  $\square$ red  **Reasoning:** _____________________________________________
